description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceTrackerMenuConfigurator class, which implements menu configuration logic for the Performance module in the OrangeHRM system. It sets up the menu to override the screen to 'viewPerformanceTracker' when invoked.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that configures menu behavior for the Performance module, overriding the screen to 'viewPerformanceTracker'. Implements the MenuConfigurator interface and uses ModuleScreenHelperTrait.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the provided Screen by overriding it to 'viewPerformanceTracker' and returns null.
